plugins.name: JODARIS Design
plugins.description: Design interface interactions, visual hierarchy, responsive layouts and accessibility. Use for human-facing UX or presentation changes; backend architecture, security controls and model behavior are outside this skill. A different project-designated provider takes precedence.

plugins.name: JODARIS Security
plugins.description: Design or review trust boundaries, identity and authorization controls, sensitive-data protection and adversarial defenses. Use when these security properties change or need assessment; routine coding, presentation and model-quality tuning are outside this skill. A different project-designated provider takes precedence.

plugins.name: JODARIS Software Engineering
plugins.description: Design module boundaries, dependency direction and public API contracts. Use for architecture or interface-contract changes; routine coding, UI/UX, security controls and model behavior are outside this skill. A different project-designated provider takes precedence.

plugins.name: JODARIS AI Engineering
plugins.description: Design prompts, retrieval behavior, model-response schemas, quality evaluations and inference budgets. Use for model-behavior changes; interface design, general software architecture and security controls are outside this skill. A different project-designated provider takes precedence.
